content.text: Ledgerline billing: invoice path at commit a41c9e2 (refunds, dunning and the customer portal are out of scope)

content.label: Invoice generation path (verified code)
content.takeaway: Verified: usage → pricing → tax → one-transaction write → publish. Not verified: the discounts read is only probable, and tax retries are unknown.

content.label: generateInvoice(accountId, period)
details: Only exported function in the file
Also called by the admin Regenerate invoice action (billing/admin/regenerate.ts)
Fixed order: collect usage → price → quote tax → write → publish
Adds the returned tax to the draft before saving

content.label: collectUsage(accountId, period)
details: Selects the account's rows whose occurred_at is in the period
Skips is_test events; groups rows by meter into usage lines
Writes to no table

content.label: priceUsage(lines, plan)
details: Loads the plan with loadPlan(planId)
Quantity × unit price, in integer cents (never floating point)
Imports discountFor: probably also reads a discount table — unconfirmed, no call site found

content.label: TaxClient.quote(draft)
details: Sends the draft to the external tax provider over HTTPS
Timeout 8 seconds (line 21)
Returns a tax amount per line
Retries: unknown — not documented; quote() has no retry code

content.label: Taxwell
details: API key read from the TAXWELL_API_KEY environment variable

content.label: invoices + invoice_lines
details: invoices rows are always written with status finalized

content.label: publishInvoiceFinalized(invoice)
details: Called only after the transaction commits
On failure: logs the error and returns, so an invoice can exist without its event
Re-sending missed events: unknown — no re-send job found

content.label: billing-events
details: Message: invoice.finalized
Subscribers: payment and email services (code not read)

content.label: Modules and data contract (LLD)
content.takeaway: Five modules behind index files; one draft type; one transactional write.

nodes.title: Five modules on the invoice path

content.markdown:
- `billing/invoices`: entry point, draft type, invoice write
- `billing/usage`: raw usage events → usage lines
- `billing/pricing`: usage lines → priced lines
- `billing/tax`: wraps the external tax provider
- `billing/events`: publishes billing events for other services

Each module exposes its functions through its own `index.ts`; modules import each other only through those files.

nodes.title: InvoiceDraft (billing/invoices/types.ts): taxCents stays undefined until the tax quote returns; BillingPeriod and PricedLine were not read
The invoice and its lines are written in one transaction

content.markdown: `generateInvoice` inserts into `invoices` and `invoice_lines` inside one database transaction (`billing/invoices/generate.ts`, lines 44–52). If either insert fails, the transaction rolls back and neither row is kept.

content.label: Interpretation and open questions
content.takeaway: The author's reading and what could not be found out; none of it is a verified code fact.

nodes.title: Author's reading: billing/pricing is the pricing boundary

content.markdown:
In effect, no code outside `billing/pricing` was seen reading `price_plans`, so a pricing change should only need edits there.

**Interpretation, not enforced:** nothing in the code stops another module from querying `price_plans` directly.

nodes.title: Author's reading: the entry point is an orchestrator

content.markdown: `generateInvoice` holds no pricing or tax logic of its own and only sequences the calls.

- **Monthly run:** unknown. The admin action is clear, but no scheduler that calls `generateInvoice` for every account was found.
- **Owner of billing-events:** unknown; none is listed in the repository.
- **invoices status column:** purpose unknown; every row is written as `finalized` (it may be reserved for drafts).
